messages.content: 一個1公斤的冰塊在0°C被加熱到100°C，在1大氣壓下，其熵變化為多少焦耳/開氏度？

function.name: entropy_change_calculate
function.description: Calculate the change in entropy for a mass of a specific substance under set initial and final conditions. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

substance.description: The substance for which the change in entropy is calculated.

mass.description: The mass of the substance in kg.

initial_temperature.description: The initial temperature of the substance in degree Celsius.

final_temperature.description: The final temperature of the substance in degree Celsius.

pressure.description: The pressure the substance is under in atmospheres.

message.reasoning: The user asks: "一個1公斤的冰塊在0°C被加熱到100°C，在1大氣壓下，其熵變化為多少焦耳/開氏度？" They want the entropy change in J/K for heating 1 kg of ice from 0°C to 100°C at 1 atm. We need to calculate ΔS = ∫ dQ_rev/T. For phase change at constant T, ΔS = ΔH/T. For heating ice from 0°C to 0°C? Actually ice at 0°C to melt at 0°C: latent heat of fusion L_f = 334 kJ/kg. Then heating water from 0°C to 100°C: specific heat c_water = 4.18 kJ/(kg·K). Then boiling at 100°C: latent heat of vaporization L_v = 2260 kJ/kg. Then heating steam from 100°C to 100°C? Actually no further heating. So total ΔS = L_f/T_melt + ∫ c_water dT / T + L_v/T_boil. But we need to consider that the process is irreversible? But we can approximate reversible path: heating ice at 0°C to melt at 0°C (latent heat at 0°C), then heating water from 0°C to 100°C (reversible heating), then vaporizing at 100°C (latent heat at 100°C). So ΔS = L_f/T_melt + ∫_0^100 c_water dT / T + L_v/T_boil. T in Kelvin: 273.15 K for melting, 373.15 K for boiling. So compute: L_f = 334 kJ/kg = 334000 J/kg. L_v = 2260 kJ/kg = 2260000 J/kg. c_water = 4184 J/(kg·K). So ΔS = 334000/273.15 + ∫_0^100 4184 dT / (273.15+T) + 2260000/373.15. Compute integral: ∫_0^100 4184 dT / (273.15+T) = 4184 * ln((273.15+100)/273.15) = 4184 * ln(373.15/273.15). ln(373.15/273.15) = ln(1.366) ≈ 0.312. So integral ≈ 4184 * 0.312 = 1305 J/K. Now compute first term: 334000/273.15 ≈ 1222 J/K. Third term: 2260000/373.15 ≈ 6057 J/K. Sum: 1222 + 1305 + 6057 = 8584 J/K. So ΔS ≈ 8584 J/K. The user asked "焦耳/開氏度" which is J/K. So answer ~8600 J/K. Provide explanation.
